title: Task progress response
description: 200 response to POST /api/v1/tasks/<id>/progress. Progress is recorded only while the task is running; for a task the server has already finished (for example timed out) it is ignored, and state says so.

state.description: The task's state on the server.

cancel.description: Stop this task (P3-S05): sent while the task is running, its type is interruptible, and an operator asked to cancel it. The agent stops it and reports outcome cancelled. Absent or null means no instruction. Additive (DEC-20).

id.description: The id of the running task to stop.
